scenario: A dental insurance adjuster reviews an oral-surgery claim submitted by a patient who underwent a third-molar extraction with alveoloplasty. The clinical note from the oral surgeon is first parsed to extract diagnoses and procedural entities, then routed to a medical coding assistant to assign ICD-10 diagnosis codes and CPT procedure codes, and finally submitted to the insurance claims processor for coverage determination and settlement recommendation.
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor parses the oral surgeon's clinical note and produces structured entities (diagnoses, procedures, medications, symptoms) → icd10-cpt-coding-assistant maps those entities to ICD-10 diagnosis codes and CPT procedure codes with confidence scores → afrexai-insurance-claims receives the structured coding output and renders a coverage determination, reserve estimate, and settlement recommendation.
